model_overview.title: Model Overview
model_overview.description:
Get a high-level view of the model. Prefer model_context first for task-oriented/cache-aware context; use model_overview when you explicitly need a hierarchy/tree/interface overview.

Get a high-level view of the model showing subsystem hierarchy, interfaces, and connections. Use this when first encountering a model to understand the big picture before diving into details.

scope.description: Focus on specific subsystem. Use 'root' for entire model or a block ID like 'blk_10' for a specific subsystem

detail.description: Level of detail: 'tree' (component hierarchy only — no port or signal info), 'interfaces' (component hierarchy + input/output port names for each component), or 'full' (component hierarchy + port names + top-level component signal connections)

model_read.title: Model Read
model_read.description:
Inspect the structure and algorithmic behavior of a Simulink model. Prefer model_context first for engineering tasks or initial model understanding because it is cache-aware and compact; use model_read when you specifically need SATK algorithmic expressions, block IDs, or deeper topology for a known scope.

Inspect the structure and algorithmic behavior of a Simulink model. Returns block topology, connections, and expressions showing what each block does.

Expression notation: uN(source) = input port N with source block.port in parentheses; yN = output port N; @Param(value) = parameter with actual set-value from the block. Example: y1 = @Gain(Kp) * u1(blk_5.y1) means output 1 = Gain parameter times input 1 (from block 5's output 1). When value is numeric (e.g., @Gain(5000)), you have the final value. When value is a variable reference (e.g., @Gain(Kp)), use model_resolve_params to get the numeric value.

Model Reference, Subsystem Reference, and Library blocks show interfaces only, not internal content.

scope.description: Starting scope - use 'root' for model top level or a block ID like 'blk_16'

depth.description: Hierarchy depth limit as string. '0'=current level only, '1'=one level down, 'inf'=full hierarchy

model_query_params.title: Model Query Params
model_query_params.description:
Provides random access to any Simulink parameter on blocks, signals, or model configuration. Complements model_read by exposing values not included in the model graph.

Use when you need:
- Parameters not in model_read expressions (sample times, state names, port dimensions)
- Model configuration (Solver, StopTime, RelTol, code generation options)
- Signal properties beyond names (DataLogging, OutDataTypeStr, Min, Max)
- Targeted verification after model_configure without re-reading the full graph

If model_read already shows the value in an expression (e.g., @Gain(Kp)), you have the set-value. Use model_resolve_params to resolve variable references to numeric values.

Use compile=true only if certain the parameter requires compilation (e.g., CompiledPortWidths). If unsure, use default; PARAM_UNAVAILABLE error will indicate if compile is needed.

targets.description: JSON array of target IDs - blocks (blk_5), signals (blk_5.y1 -> blk_8.u1), or config (config:ModelName)

params.description: JSON array of param names like '["Gain", "SampleTime"]' or '["all"]' for all parameters

compile.description: Compile model before querying ('true' or 'false'). Required for compiled params like CompiledPortWidths

model_resolve_params.title: Model Resolve Params
model_resolve_params.description:
Resolve variable references from model_read expressions to actual numeric values. When model_read shows @Param(Kp), this tool returns the value of Kp from MATLAB workspaces.

Pass expressions exactly as seen in model_read (e.g., "Kp", "cfg.gains.Ki", "TableData(1,:)"). Searches base workspace, model workspace, mask workspaces, and data dictionaries.

Results organized by workspace source; shadowed variables include users list to identify which blocks use each definition.

Unsupported: arithmetic (Kp+Ki), function calls (sqrt(2)), matrix literals ([1 2 3]). Use evaluate_matlab_code for these.

expressions.description: JSON array of expressions to resolve, e.g. '["Kp", "cfg.gains.Ki"]'

model_edit.title: Model Edit
model_edit.description:
Make structural changes or configure parameters in a Simulink, System Composer, or Stateflow model within ONE scope per call. Use model_read first to get block IDs.

Operations (executed in array order):
- add_block: {op, type, name?, ref?, params?, position?} - Add block or SF element. SL params e.g. {Gain: "2.0"}; SF types: State, Junction, Box, Data, Event, Message, StateflowFunction, EMFunction, TruthTable
- connect: {op, target: "blk_X.y1 -> blk_Y.u1", params?} - Wire output to input (y=output port, u=input port); for physical ports use blk_X.portName <-> blk_Y.portName; in SF scope use portless "#src -> #dst" or "? -> #dst" (default transition); replaces existing connection if destination port occupied; params set signal properties (SL) or LabelString/ExecutionOrder (SF)
- disconnect: {op, target: "blk_X.y1 -> blk_Y.u1"} - Remove connection; in SF scope target is transition sf_X, endpoint pair "sf_X -> sf_Y", or default "? -> sf_X"
- configure: {op, target, params} - Set Simulink parameters, System Composer component properties, or SF element properties. Target types: blk_X (block params), sf_X (SF element, e.g. {LabelString: "..."}), blk_X.y1 -> blk_Y.u1 (signal props), config:ModelName (solver settings), or chart:ModelName (SF chart-level props, e.g. {ActionLanguage: "MATLAB"})
- delete: {op, target: "blk_X"} - Remove block
- replace_block: {op, target: "blk_X", type, ref?, params?} - Replace block with different type; preserves name, position, connections
- create_subsystem: {op, name, ref?, interface: {inputs, outputs}} - Create subsystem; connect via #ref.yN/#ref.uN (N = port number from interface)

For parameter-only changes (no structural edits), use configure operations alone.

Chaining: Use "ref" to name a new block, "#ref" to reference it within the same call:
  [{op: "add_block", type: "Gain", ref: "g1"}, {op: "connect", target: "blk_5.y1 -> #g1.u1"}]

Response "created" map shows ref → blk_id (or sf_X in SF scope). In subsequent calls, use the returned ID instead of #ref. Use model_query_params to discover valid parameter names. Operations continue on error.

IMPORTANT: The operations parameter MUST be single-line JSON with no newlines.

scope.description: Where to operate: 'root', subsystem block ID 'blk_5', or Stateflow scope 'sf_X' (chart/state/box). Chart blk_X auto-detects as SF. All ops within this scope.

operations.description: JSON array of operation objects (MUST be single-line, no newlines). Each has 'op' (add_block|connect|disconnect|configure|delete|replace_block|create_subsystem) and operation-specific fields.

layout_mode.description: Layout mode for this call: 'full' (use when scope is empty/building from scratch) or 'incremental' (use when adding to existing model). Always provide this parameter.

model_check.title: Model Check
model_check.description:
Validate a Simulink model for structural issues. Prefer model_context first when deciding what scope to inspect; then run model_check on the narrowest relevant scope after edits or when structural validation is explicitly needed.

Validate a Simulink model for structural issues. Detects unconnected ports, dangling signal lines, and Stateflow edit-time lint errors. Use after model_edit to catch connectivity problems, or to audit an existing model's structural health.

Checks available:
- unconnected_ports: blocks with inputs/outputs that have no signal connected
- unconnected_lines: signal lines missing a source or destination
- stateflow_lint: edit-time lint diagnostics on Chart and StateTransitionTable blocks

Returns issue list with severity (error/warning), block IDs, and actionable messages. Use scope to focus on a specific subsystem for faster, targeted validation.

scope.description: Validation scope: 'root' for entire model or a block ID like 'blk_10' for a specific subsystem

checks.description: JSON array of check names to run: '["all"]' (default), or selective like '["unconnected_ports", "unconnected_lines"]'. Available: unconnected_ports, unconnected_lines, stateflow_lint

model_test.title: Model Test
model_test.description: Execute behavioral tests against a Simulink model using a Gherkin-format specification file. Auto-creates test artifacts and returns pytest-style results. IMPORTANT: Load the 'testing-simulink-models' skill before writing .feature files — the Gherkin format requires TOML front-matter and custom step syntax not found in standard Gherkin. ROUTING: When a user asks to 'generate tests', 'write test cases', or 'verify requirements' for a Simulink model or subsystem, ALWAYS use this tool with the testing-simulink-models skill — never write matlab.unittest.TestCase classes that reimplement model logic in MATLAB.

gherkin_file.description: Path to Gherkin test specification file

scenarios.description: JSON array of scenario names to run, e.g. '["Scenario1", "Scenario2"]'. Use '[]' to run all scenarios.

verbose.description: Include signal traces on failure ('true' or 'false'). Default: false

draft_mode.description: Skip main model compile for faster iteration ('true' or 'false'). Use 'true' by default for rapid test development (~3s vs ~60s). If draft mode fails due to type/bus/dimension issues, re-run with 'false'. Default: false

coverage.description: Coverage metric to collect: 'none' (default) or 'decision'. Requires Simulink Coverage toolbox.

model_cache_status.name: model_cache_status
model_cache_status.title: Model Cache Status
model_cache_status.description: Check whether a project-local, scope/detail Simulink analysis cache record exists and is fresh. Does not run live model analysis.

scope.description: Scope: root or Simulink block/subsystem path

model_cache_get.name: model_cache_get
model_cache_get.title: Model Cache Get
model_cache_get.description: Return a cached Simulink analysis record for model/scope/detail without live analysis.

model_cache_update.name: model_cache_update
model_cache_update.title: Model Cache Update
model_cache_update.description: Run cheap compile-free scoped Simulink analysis and update the project-local cache. Prototype supports summary analysis with depth 1.

analysis.description: JSON array of analysis names, currently ["summary"]

model_analyze_cached.name: model_analyze_cached
model_analyze_cached.title: Model Analyze Cached
model_analyze_cached.description: Cache-first scoped Simulink analysis. Returns fresh cache if available; otherwise runs the minimum cheap live analysis and updates cache. Prototype is compile-free and summary-oriented.

checks.description: JSON array of requested checks/details, currently ["summary"]

model_context.name: model_context
model_context.title: Model Context
model_context.description: FIRST-CHOICE tool for cache-aware Simulink working context. Use this before model_overview/model_read for engineering tasks, feature changes, debugging, or when first encountering a model. It resolves model/scope when set to auto, uses cached project/model/block context, avoids full recursive analysis and compile by default, and returns compact relevant context plus suggested next tool calls.

scope.description: root, auto, or Simulink block/subsystem path

budget.description: cheap, normal, or deep. Prototype honors cheap behavior.

model_cache_invalidate.name: model_cache_invalidate
model_cache_invalidate.title: Model Cache Invalidate
model_cache_invalidate.description: Invalidate project-local Simulink cache records for a model/scope plus the block index. Use after model_edit or manual model changes; the next model_context call refreshes lazily.

model.description: Model filename/path or loaded model name

scope.description: root or Simulink block/subsystem path to invalidate

model_project_setup.title: Model Project Setup
model_project_setup.description: Prepare MATLAB/SATK and run a project startup script for OA/Simulink workflows. Returns setup status, tool availability, and repo inventory.

repo.description: Project or repository root path, or auto for current folder

startup.description: Startup script path relative to repo or absolute, e.g. matlab/startup.m

toolkit_root.description: Optional SATK repo root to add to MATLAB path

model_project_inventory.title: Model Project Inventory
model_project_inventory.description: Cache-aware discovery of Simulink models, libraries, dictionaries, harnesses, Simulink Test Manager files, feature files, and MATLAB scripts in a repo.

model_harness_list.title: Model Harness List
model_harness_list.description: Cache-aware list of Simulink Test harnesses for a model or component using sltest.harness.find.

component.description: Harness owner component path or auto

searchDepth.description: Search depth: all or nonnegative integer

model_harness_create.title: Model Harness Create
model_harness_create.description: Create a Simulink Test harness using sltest.harness.create. After creation, use model_harness_open and model_read/model_edit to edit harness contents.

save_externally.description: true/false, save harness as external SLX

source.description: Harness source type, e.g. Inport, Signal Editor, From Workspace

sink.description: Harness sink type, e.g. Outport, Scope, To Workspace

model_harness_open.title: Model Harness Open
model_harness_open.description: Open an existing Simulink Test harness for editing. Then use model_read/model_edit on the opened harness model.

model_harness_save.title: Model Harness Save
model_harness_save.description: Save an open Simulink Test harness.

model_harness_close.title: Model Harness Close
model_harness_close.description: Close an open Simulink Test harness, optionally saving first.

model_test_manager_list.title: Model Test Manager List
model_test_manager_list.description: Cache-aware inspection of a Simulink Test Manager .mldatx file. Lists suites, test cases, harness mappings, stop times, modes, assessments, baselines, and iteration counts.

model_test_manager_create_case.title: Model Test Manager Create Case
model_test_manager_create_case.description: Create a native Simulink Test Manager test case in an existing .mldatx file, optionally assigning model/component/harness and stop time.

model_test_manager_configure_case.title: Model Test Manager Configure Case
model_test_manager_configure_case.description: Configure a native Simulink Test Manager test case. The config JSON object supports enabled, model, harness, harness_owner, stop_time, start_time, simulation_mode, callbacks, and arbitrary setProperty values.

test_case.description: Test case name or full TestPath

config.description: JSON object with supported configuration fields

model_test_manager_run.title: Model Test Manager Run
model_test_manager_run.description: Run selected or full native Simulink Test Manager tests. Default runner uses MATLAB unittest testsuite(.mldatx) for repo/CI compatibility and can emit JUnit/PDF artifacts.

tests.description: JSON array of selected full/partial test names; [] runs all

model_test_manager_results.title: Model Test Manager Results
model_test_manager_results.description: Cache-aware summary of JUnit XML test results or latest Simulink Test Manager result sets.

result_source.description: JUnit XML path, e.g. matlab/work/results/TestReport.xml, or empty for default
